title: Smallest n So 1+2+…+n Is a Multiple of 2024 | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
Add 1 + 2 + 3 + ... up to n. What is the smallest n that makes the total a multiple of 2024? Vantee shows a neat trick: neighbors like n and n+1 share no factors, so each piece of 2024 goes whole into one of them. You will also see a fast way to test the choices, why 736 works but still isn't the answer, and a 2025 puzzle to try yourself.
